name: Macrogol (Movicol/Laxido)
mechanism: Polyethylene glycol increases water content of stool via osmosis
dosing: Chronic constipation: 1-3 sachets daily. Faecal impaction: 8 sachets daily for 3 days
contraindications: Intestinal perforation/obstruction, severe inflammatory bowel disease, toxic megacolon
interactions: May reduce absorption of other oral medications (give 1h apart)
monitoring: Bowel movements, fluid balance (elderly), electrolytes if prolonged use
sideEffects: Abdominal pain, flatulence, nausea, electrolyte disturbance (rare)
pharmacokinetics: Not absorbed systemically, works locally in GI tract
clinicalPearls: Very commonly prescribed in UK. Safe for long-term use. Can be used in pregnancy
indication: Chronic constipation (first-line), faecal impaction, bowel preparation
